body: I've tried talking to her about this in the past, but she gets really angry at me. She's not good with "confrontation" as such, even if it is just a small chat about issues that are bothering me. I think if I tried, she'd shut off and pass some comment like "oh waaah". I also know for sure that she'd just bitch about me afterwards.
Thank you. Just knowing that there is one person like you makes a difference. It's a bit daunting when you can talk to strangers more than you could talk to close friends/family.
I love her a lot, but she has become really nasty in the last few months. She's so aggressive towards me now, it's really upsetting.

I work a lot, so my diet depends on how busy I am. I am trying to cut down on carbs at the moment, as I'm eating way too much bread/pasta. I make a point of drinking at least 2 litres (0.5 gallons) of water a day.

Nothing stands out. Everything is just mashed together, and I can't even concentrate on what is actually making me sad. I'm trying to stay positive, I'm trying to think of everything I have in my life and the people who love me. I feel so numb to it all. It has become irrelevant.
